name: LenoChat
author: lenochat

sections.description:
✨ LenoChat is an all-in-one customer experience solution — combining live chat, chatbot, AI-powered Copilot, and multichannel messaging in one simple tool.

LenoChat is the easiest way to connect with your customers — wherever they are. Whether you’re a small business, online store, or growing team, LenoChat brings all your conversations into one clean, AI-powered inbox.

✅ Key Features

  • Multi-Channel Messaging – Manage chats from your website, WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook — all in one place.
  • AI-Powered Assistance – Let our built-in AI suggest replies, saving you time and improving response quality.
  • Real-Time Support – See what customers are typing as they type, enabling faster, more personalised responses.
  • Customisable Chat Widget – Match your brand with customisable colors, logos, and greetings.
  • Team Collaboration – Add team members to handle customer inquiries efficiently.
  • Operating Hours Control – Set your chat availability to manage customer expectations and team workload.

💡 Why Choose LenoChat?

  • User-Friendly Interface – Designed for simplicity, so you can focus on your customers, not the software.
  • No Unnecessary Features – Includes only what you need — no clutter, no complexity.
  • Affordable Pricing – Start with our free plan, which includes all core features. Upgrade as your business grows.

📱 Mobile Apps for a Convenient Live Chat

Available on mobile:
* iOS
* Android

Privacy Policy

LenoChat respects user privacy. For more information, visit our Privacy Policy.
sections.faq:
What is LenoChat?

LenoChat is an all-in-one customer communication platform that helps you chat with your website visitors in real time. It includes live chat, a smart AI Copilot & Leno AI Agent (Chatbot), and integrations with popular channels like WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook — all in one simple dashboard.

Who should use LenoChat?

LenoChat is perfect for:
* Small to medium-sized businesses
* E-commerce store owners
* Customer support teams
* Freelancers or solo entrepreneurs
Basically, anyone who wants to offer fast, friendly, and professional support — without complicated tools.

Do I need coding skills to use the LenoChat WordPress plugin?

Not at all! LenoChat is built for everyone — no technical knowledge needed. Just install the plugin and your chat widget will be live in minutes.

What social media channels can I connect to LenoChat?

You can connect:
* WhatsApp
* Instagram
* Facebook Messenger

All messages from these channels will appear in one shared inbox alongside your website chats.

Can I use LenoChat for free?

Yes! LenoChat offers a generous free plan with all core features included. See our pricing page for details.

Does LenoChat work on mobile?

Yes — LenoChat has mobile apps with push notifications (iOS & Android) so you can chat with customers from anywhere.

Can I customise the chat widget to match my brand?

Absolutely. You can change colours, greetings, logos, and even set your business hours — all from your LenoChat dashboard.
